items.prompt: Ultra-clean dark-mode desktop web application UI screenshot: a professional SSH remote file explorer product called SSH Explorer, shown full screen. Three-pane layout. FAR-LEFT SIDEBAR, 250px: small wordmark SSH Explorer top-left; section label CONNECTIONS in 10px letterspaced uppercase grey; below it a flat list of saved hosts, each row 44px tall with a 7px status dot on the left (mint for online, grey for idle), host name prod-web-01 in 13px white and user@10.0.4.11:22 underneath in 11px grey monospace; the selected row has a slightly lighter background and a 2px mint vertical bar on its left edge; then a collapsed TRANSFERS section with two thin mint progress rows. CENTER PANE: a tab strip with three file tabs (active tab lighter with a 2px mint underline), a toolbar with an icon-only back, forward and up button group, a breadcrumb path / var www production rendered as small monospace segments with thin chevron separators, a right-aligned search field with a magnifier icon and a segmented list and grid view toggle. Below it a dense file table, 30px rows separated by hairlines: header row NAME SIZE MODIFIED PERMISSIONS OWNER in 10px letterspaced uppercase grey with a sort chevron on SIZE; each row has a 16px outline folder or file icon, filename in 13px light grey, metadata columns in 11px monospace grey; one row is selected with a soft mint tinted background and a 1px mint left border. RIGHT INSPECTOR, 290px, separated by a hairline: the selected file name in 15px white, a square file-type tile, a definition list with metadata keys in 10px uppercase grey and monospace values, and a small text preview block with line numbers on a darker inset surface. BOTTOM STATUS BAR, 28px: left connected, 12 ms; right 24 items, 1.2 GB. Restrained dark technical palette: page #0A0C10, panels #101419, inset #07090C, hairlines rgba(255,255,255,0.06), text #E6EAF0, muted #8A93A0, one single mint-teal accent #5EE6C4. Flat: no gradients, no glows, no drop shadows, no rounded card containers, panes separated only by hairlines. Sans-serif UI type, monospace for paths and numbers. High information density with generous breathing room, crisp sharp legible UI text, professional product screenshot.

Dark professional desktop application UI screenshot of SSH Explorer, a remote file browser over SSH, 1024x768. Left sidebar 250px: wordmark, CONNECTIONS section label, saved host rows with colored status dots and monospace user@host lines, one active row highlighted with a mint left bar. Main area: tab strip with three tabs, toolbar with back forward up icon buttons, monospace breadcrumb path with chevron separators, search field, list and grid toggle. Dense file table with hairline row separators, uppercase 10px grey column headers NAME SIZE MODIFIED PERMISSIONS OWNER, 16px outline folder and file icons, filenames 13px, metadata 11px monospace, one selected row with mint tint and mint left border. Right inspector 290px: file name, file type tile, metadata definition list, small line-numbered text preview on a darker inset. Bottom status bar with connection latency and item count. Palette: background #0A0C10, panels #101419, hairline borders, text #E6EAF0, muted #8A93A0, single mint-teal accent #5EE6C4. Flat minimal, no gradients, no shadows, no cards, crisp legible text, high density, professional product screenshot.

Dark-mode desktop web application UI screenshot of a professional SSH client in split view, 1024x768. Top region: a remote file explorer pane with a toolbar containing a monospace breadcrumb path and small icon buttons, and a compact file list with folder and file icons and grey metadata columns. Middle: a docked file TRANSFER QUEUE panel with a header row and three transfer rows, each row has a small file icon, a filename in 12px light grey, right-aligned speed text 48.2 MB/s in 11px monospace, and a thin 3px mint progress bar underneath; one completed row shows a muted check icon. Bottom region: an integrated terminal drawer, on a darker inset surface, with a tab bar holding two tabs labelled shell - prod-web-01 and shell - db-replica, then monospace terminal text: a prompt line user@prod-web-01:~$ ls -la in white, several grey directory listing lines, a mint success line, and a solid block cursor. Restrained dark palette: page #0A0C10, panels #101419, terminal inset #07090C, hairline separators, muted grey #8A93A0, single mint-teal accent #5EE6C4. Flat: no gradients, no glows, no drop shadows, no rounded card containers. Crisp monospace typography, high density, professional product screenshot.

Dark-mode desktop web application modal dialog screenshot, 1024x768, two dialogs floating over a dimmed blurred file explorer background. MAIN DIALOG, centered, 480px wide, surface #101419 with a 1px hairline border and slightly darker scrim behind: title New connection in 16px white semibold with a small close X at top right; stacked form fields with 10px letterspaced uppercase grey labels: Host with value prod-web-01.internal, Port with value 22, Username with value deploy; an Authentication segmented control with three options Password, Private key, Agent where Private key is active with a mint tinted background and mint text; a Private key path field showing ~/.ssh/id_ed25519; a Passphrase field with masked dots; a collapsed Advanced row; footer right-aligned with a ghost Cancel button and a solid mint Connect button with dark text. SECOND SMALLER DIALOG to the lower right: heading Unknown host key, a warning line, a long monospace SHA256 fingerprint string in grey on a darker inset, and two buttons Cancel and Trust and continue. Palette: page #0A0C10, panels #101419, inset #07090C, hairline borders, text #E6EAF0, muted #8A93A0, mint accent #5EE6C4, amber warning #F5A524. Flat minimal, no gradients, no glows, crisp legible text, professional product screenshot.
